title: Nourishing Chewy French Perilla Seeds Confit
description: A hearty and comforting French dish from Brittany featuring perilla seeds, cooked in a clay pot with ayurvedic rajasic friendly ingredients, this confit is a perfect blend of mustardy and chewy textures. It is a cozy meal to warm up on a chilly day.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the perilla seeds and soak them in water for 4 hours.
Drain and rinse the perilla seeds, then set them aside.
Heat the olive oil in a clay pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mustard seeds, sea salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the soaked perilla seeds, water, and chopped parsley to the clay pot.
Cover the clay pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Cook the confit for 2 hours, or until the perilla seeds are chewy and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the clay pot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
